svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 360 mm lengths of 40 x 40 x 4 angle; square and deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flat leg (goes on the back of the panel frame): two 6.5 mm holes,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 10 mm from each end, 20 mm out from the upright leg's outer face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upright leg: two 10.5 mm holes, 22 mm out from the flat leg's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outer face: the pivot at mid-length (180 mm from each end) and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the tilt bolt 60 mm from the pivot toward the panel's low edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Left and right rails are mirror images: drill the upright legs

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: clamped back to back so the holes line up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the flat legs bolt across the frame's back lip at its two long

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edges, 61 to 101 mm each side of the panel's centre line; the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: upright legs stand down and bolt to the outside of the cheeks.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: hole centres 60 and 340 mm apart, within 0.5 mm.
